metadata.question: Does the urban area of Medina, Saudi Arabia expand between June, 1984 and July, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Medina, Saudi Arabia (approximate coordinates: 24.47°N, 39.61°E) - Time periods: June 1984 and July 2018 - Collections: Landsat 5 for 1984, Landsat 8 for 2018 - Need to detect urban expansion using appropriate indices (NDVI, NDBI, or urban classification) 2. Masking strategy: - Apply cloud masking for both periods - The question is about urban expansion, not clouds, so mask them out - Use QA bands for cloud masking 3. Logic: - Calculate urban area for both periods - Urban areas typically have: low NDVI, high NDBI, or can use NIR/SWIR bands - Compare urban extent between 1984 and 2018 - Valid Zero: If urban area calculation yields 0 (unlikely for Medina) - A (Yes): If 2018 urban area > 1984 urban area significantly - B (No): If 2018 urban area <= 1984 urban area - C1: If no images found for either period - C2: If no valid pixels after masking - C3: If calculation fails or returns null/invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Medina, Saudi Arabia const medina = ee.Geometry.Point([39.61, 24.47]); const region = medina.buffer(15000); // 15km radius around city center // 2. Data acquisition for 1984 (Landsat 5) const l5_1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('1984-06-01', '1984-06-30') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const count1984 = l5_1984.size().getInfo(); console.log('1984 Images found:', count1984); if (count1984 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 5 data for June 1984, trying wider date range'); const l5_1984_wide = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('1984-05-01', '1984-07-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); if (l5_1984_wide.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Data acquisition for 2018 (Landsat 8) const l8_2018 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2018-07-01', '2018-07-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const count2018 = l8_2018.size().getInfo(); console.log('2018 Images found:', count2018); if (count2018 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Cloud masking function for Landsat function maskL8sr(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); const saturationMask = image.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask).updateMask(saturationMask) .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); } function maskL5sr(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); const saturationMask = image.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask).updateMask(saturationMask) .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); } // 5. Process images and calculate NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) const img1984 = l5_1984.map(maskL5sr).median(); const img2018 = l8_2018.map(maskL8sr).median(); // NDBI = (SWIR - NIR) / (SWIR + NIR) // Landsat 5: Band 5 (SWIR1=SR_B5), Band 4 (NIR=SR_B4) // Landsat 8: Band 6 (SWIR1=SR_B6), Band 5 (NIR=SR_B5) const ndbi1984 = img1984.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDBI'); const ndbi2018 = img2018.normalizedDifference(['SR_B6', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDBI'); // Urban areas typically have NDBI > 0 const urban1984 = ndbi1984.gt(0); const urban2018 = ndbi2018.gt(0); // 6. Calculate urban area const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const urbanArea1984 = urban1984.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI'); const urbanArea2018 = urban2018.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI'); const validPixels1984 = urban1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI'); const validPixels2018 = urban2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDBI'); const area1984_val = await urbanArea1984.getInfo(); const area2018_val = await urbanArea2018.getInfo(); const pixels1984 = await validPixels1984.getInfo(); const pixels2018 = await validPixels2018.getInfo(); console.log('Valid pixels 1984:', pixels1984); console.log('Valid pixels 2018:', pixels2018); if (pixels1984 === 0 || pixels2018 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } if (area1984_val === null || area2018_val === null) { console.log('C3'); return; } const area1984_km2 = area1984_val / 1e6; const area2018_km2 = area2018_val / 1e6; console.log('Urban area 1984:', area1984_km2.toFixed(2), 'km²'); console.log('Urban area 2018:', area2018_km2.toFixed(2), 'km²'); console.log('Expansion:', (area2018_km2 - area1984_km2).toFixed(2), 'km²'); if (area2018_km2 > area1984_km2 * 1.1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
